description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'NodeTermData' that manages relationships between nodes and taxonomy terms within Drupal views, including configuration and query building logic.

classes.name: NodeTermData
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that handles relationships to retrieve taxonomy terms associated with nodes in views.
